item.title: Former Milwaukee tax preparer pleads guilty in $1 million refund inflation scheme
item.description: Former tax preparer Cameron Summers pleaded guilty to filing false tax returns that inflated client refunds, causing more than $1.1 million in IRS losses.

item.title: Wisconsin secures millions in EV infrastructure funding blocked by Trump administration
item.description: A federal judge blocked the Trump administration from withholding NEVI funds, protecting $62.5M for Wisconsin EV charging projects statewide.

item.title: Badger Meter bringing work for Puerto Rico project to its Racine plant
item.description: Brown Deer-based Badger Meter plans to make products for a project aimed at modernizing Puerto Rico’s water infrastructure at its plant in Racine, company executives said Wednesday. The Puerto Rico Aqueduct and Sewer Authority selected Badger meter after a multi-year competitive pilot. The project includes the company’s ultrasonic water meters, cellular endpoints and software-as-a-service offerings. […]

item.title: Lakeland University will open office on Moraine Park Technical College’s Fond du Lac campus
item.description: Lakeland University will open an office on Moraine Park Technical College’s Fond du Lac campus next month, the university announced Monday.
